description: This file defines an abstract class 'DownloadFormat' within the OrangeHRM system that provides a blueprint for formatting download data related to employees. It includes methods for generating filenames based on employee data and an abstract method for data formatting.

classes.name: DownloadFormat
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for different download formats, providing common functionality for file naming and access to employee data.

methods.name: getFormattedString
methods.description: An abstract method intended to be implemented by subclasses to return a formatted string of values.

methods.name: getDownloadFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for the download based on the employee's full name and whether they are a past employee, appending a '.json' extension.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeService, initializing it if it hasn't been created yet.
